subject: NovaEdge: addendum for subcontractor addition + DPA tweak
messages:
From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@novaedge.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: contracts@novaedge.com
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Notice: onboarding of 'EdgeOps' subcontractor + proposed DPA excerpt

Hi Stephanie,

Quick heads-up from NovaEdge legal: we are planning to onboard a small monitoring/subcontractor (EdgeOps Inc.) who will process logs for one specific ingest pipeline. Attached is a short addendum (redline on our MSA) and a DPA excerpt that shows the exact subprocessor scope. We think this is low-impact, but our compliance team asked that you confirm Redwood's acceptance of the flow-down language and confirm whether an Order Form amendment is needed for billing or data residency.

Attachments: NovaEdge_Addendum_v1_redline.docx, NovaEdge_DPA_excerpt.pdf

Planned effective date from their side: 2026-12-01 (they want to be ready for a phased rollout).

Would appreciate a quick confirmation or list of questions by EOD Thursday so they can schedule the onboarding kickoff.

Thanks,
Maria Gomez
Senior Contracts Manager
NovaEdge Cloud

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 09:01:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Notice: onboarding of 'EdgeOps' subcontractor + proposed DPA excerpt

Forwarding NovaEdge's notice for legal + security review. TL;DR: vendor wants to add EdgeOps (monitoring/logs) and included redline + DPA excerpt.

What I need:
- Legal: can we accept the proposed flow-down language (see redline) or do you need changes?
- Security: quick risk call — is this subprocessor pattern okay if we require scoping & limited access?
- Procurement: will this trigger any order-form change or fee?

Goal: provide a single list of asks back to Maria (contracts@novaedge.com) by EOD Thursday so they've got time to schedule onboarding.

Attachments forwarded.

Thanks,
Steph
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0198

---
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Notice: onboarding of 'EdgeOps' subcontractor + proposed DPA excerpt

Thanks for the ping. Quick security notes after a 30m pass on the attachments:
- Scope looks limited to log ingestion and short-term retention for monitoring (not customer PII). Good.
- Request that we add: (a) strict ACLs limiting access to only named service accounts, (b) explicit retention period (30 days) in the addendum, and (c) prohibition on materializing raw customer inputs outside of our controlled environment.
- We should require an updated dataflow diagram showing how logs leave NovaEdge, pass through EdgeOps, and any persistent stores. I attached a small sketch (dataflow-diagram.svg) for reference.

If Legal is comfortable, Security can sign off conditional on: the explicit retention clause and the dataflow diagram being provided prior to go-live.

-Aditya
Principal Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

---
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 13:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Notice: onboarding of 'EdgeOps' subcontractor + proposed DPA excerpt

I've reviewed NovaEdge's addendum redline. Summary and proposed path: 
- The vendor's draft is mostly reasonable but we should: (1) lock retention to 30 days (per security note), (2) add a clause that any further subcontracting by EdgeOps requires NovaEdge to notify Redwood and obtain our prior written consent, and (3) include a carve-out that EdgeOps cannot use the data to develop their own models or product offerings.

Proposed edits I've pasted inline in the redline (sent to Maria if needed). Legal is OK to accept the addendum if NovaEdge returns an updated version with those three items.

Ask for Procurement: will an Order Form amendment be required if NovaEdge is simply adding EdgeOps as subcontractor without pricing impact? Laura, can you confirm whether we need formal acceptance on the Order Form side or this can be handled via a signed addendum to the MSA?

Markus Klein
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference

---
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Notice: onboarding of 'EdgeOps' subcontractor + proposed DPA excerpt

Thanks — procurement perspective:
- If there is no change to pricing, billing, or SLAs, we can handle this via a signed addendum to the MSA alone (no Order Form amendment required).
- If the vendor later requests SKUs or different SLAs tied to EdgeOps, we'll need to update the Order Form and run the billing change (will require PO amendment).
- Please ensure the addendum includes the retention period and subcontracting-notice language (Legal items). Once NovaEdge returns the updated doc, Procurement will countersign the addendum in parallel with Legal.

I'll also add a short internal procurement approval ticket (PO not required) to document the change. JIRA: PROC-879 (link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/PROC-879).

Laura Bennett
Vendor Ops / Procurement
Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@novaedge.com>, contracts@novaedge.com
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 15:24:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Notice: onboarding of 'EdgeOps' subcontractor + proposed DPA excerpt

Maria — thanks for the notice and for the docs. Internal review complete: Legal and Security have requested three small edits (retention = 30 days; written notice + consent for any further subcontracting; prohibition on using data to train or productize). Procurement confirms no Order Form change is required if pricing and SLAs stay the same.

Please send an updated addendum incorporating the three clauses. When you return the final addendum we can countersign; I'll also route the packet through DocuSign. For planning — a phased go-live remains OK but Security requires the final dataflow diagram before any production traffic.

Next steps for NovaEdge:
- Return updated addendum + DPA excerpt incorporating the three items requested.
- Provide a short dataflow diagram.
- We'll send a DocuSign envelope once we have the final PDFs.

For transparency, attaching the internal checklist (not sent to vendor). DocuSign link will be created and shared back after we receive the final docs.

Thanks,
Steph
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: internal-checklist.pdf
